title: Entertaining show
text: A really entertaining one hour show. We thoroughly enjoyed it and it gave us an initial introduction to flamenco. The artists were all fantastic.
author: Caroline_S

title: Unassuming venue with a unique and authentic performance
text:
An authentic and intimate show with highly experienced performers who were responsive to each other throughout the performance.  We wondered if we had the right place when we arrived as had come recommended but so glad we took the chance
- thoroughly enjoyed it!
author: maturanav

title: So much fun!
text: The atmosphere was great.  The food and beverages amazingly.  The performance breath taking. I look forward to going again.
author: Mercedes_R
